read.thesis: Aluminum restarts (San Ciprián, Alumar, Lista, Portland) lifted output 5% to 636kt and realised price to $4,752/t, but Pinjarra alumina outage cut 2026 alumina guidance and $4.1bn AliGroup deal adds acquisition capital risk.

utilisation.quote: Set year-to-date production records at four aluminum smelters and at one alumina refinery

capex.quote: Announced $65 million capital investment at the Mosjøen smelter in Norway
